answer_2.quote: We pay attention to: • Alignment with golden response, including BLEU Scores , ME-TEOR Score (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), Rouge Score (RG)  and BERT Score  • Alignment with user's past post, including -Coherence  -Predicted Human Feedback, including Humanlike , Non-Random , Depth (How many follow-up turns) , and Upvote (How many "Upvote"s against "Downvote"s)

answer_4.quote: Following , we implement interactive A-B test for human evaluation. We hired three human annotators to interact with the models in multi-turn conversation (for 100 rounds) and choose the better one in light of four criteria: Coherent, Helpful, Informative, and Overall.
